# Weapons of Miracles Expansion (WoM +)

This Mod requires Epic Fight and Weapons of Miracles to work!


It adds movesets for the following weapons:

## Evil Ôdachi:
Full Basic Moveset, Airslash, Dash, Innate, Guard Motions, Livings, Counterattack and Execution (If Combat Evolution is present)
![Evil Tachi](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a89a456531eb8f40a6997c2fab8f1b1f42f5b695.png)

### Weapon Innate:

Evil Beam:

Unleash a beam of demonic energy on your attackers!
![Evil Beam](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47ccfd7e285094f86d4268ea5b06182a741caf2a.png)

## Greataxe:

### Onehanded Style

3 Basic Attacks, Airslash, Dash, Innate, Guard Motions, Livings, Counterattack
![Greataxe Onehand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b92e0d7612f19e508c3726523c77d8215141719f.png)

### Weapon Innate
Comet:

Soar into the air and strike down upon your opponents with a devastating hit.
![Comet Innate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e555dbba8a86c12f6068f714589586629f30678.png)

### Dual Style
Full Basic Moveset, Airslash, Dash, Innate, Guard Motions, Livings and Execution (If Combat Evolution is present)
![Dual Greataxe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a851c5e06c05c2409fd4f6a2d383db83e462c25a.png)

### Weapon Innate:

Annihilate:

You leap into the air with great energy to deal critical damage to your opponents.
![Annihilate Innate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc3b9ed9afbdb4564babed02e92ca49ac1dce1fe_0.webp)

## Hollow Longsword:
(Moveset combined with Shield)
Full Basic Moveset, Airslash, Dash, Counter, Innate and Livings
![Hollow Longsword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7229855b79ea259d7e64b78a17b60f3fe35bc4e3.png)

### Weapon Innate:

RAAAAHHHH:

Increases your Defence and Stunresistance, your Attacks will be stronger and faster.
![RAAAHH Innate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5bc9101e12bbdae4c6fe03eb084f6324bff4041d.png)

## Disclaimer:

I do not hold any rights to WoM, I am not a developer of the WoM. As this mod uses assets from WoM (Items, hit animations, hit particles, weapon passives, etc.), it is dependent on WoM. All Combat Animations for the Weapons are Made by me. Some Living Animations are made by RobertOn.

### All Animations are Handmade.

## Q&A

Q: Can I include this Mod in my Modpack?

A: Of course!

Q: Can I use the Animation from this Mod?

A: Yes, but only if this mod is a dependency.

 

Q: Can I use assets from this Mod?

A: Only with Permission

Q: Can I reupload this mod somewhere else?

A: Nope.

## Incompatibilities:

Epic Fight Dawnday below 1.11.0

Every old WoM expansion that I made before this.

 

Have Fun!
